cases.title: The Mediterranean Sea
cases.description: The water body separating Africa from Europe.
steps: Countries: Highlighted in yellow are the North African countries bordering it (Egypt, Libya, Tunisia, Algeria, Morocco).

cases.title: The Red Sea
cases.description: The water body separating Africa from Asia.
steps: Border: It separates Africa from Asia (Arabian Peninsula).
Man-made link: It is connected to the Mediterranean Sea by the Suez Canal in Egypt.

cases.title: Indian & Atlantic Oceans
cases.description: The two vast oceans flanking the continent.
steps: West: The Atlantic Ocean separates Africa from the Americas.
East: The Indian Ocean separates Africa from Australia.
Meeting Point: They meet at the southern tip of Africa (Cape of Good Hope).
